There is no address on the PractitionerRole as the location that is defined here contains the address.
This prevents having to duplicate the address values across multiple resources.

As noted in the 'Scope and Usage' section, many of the elements of the PractitionerRole resource can have multiple values in a single resource instance (i.e., cardinality > 1). However, care should be taken when producing resource instances with multiple values for these elements, as each value must be valid across all the other elements in the resource instance. For example, when representing multiple locations in an instance, the rest of the content of the resource must be true for every location, including contact details, services, availabilities, endpoints, etc. When updating content in the resource, new values may break the internal consistency of that resource. In such cases, new resource instances will need to be created. Any other resources which reference the original resource instance may need to be updated to refer to the appropriate record. For this reason, IGs profile the cardinality of these repeated elements to a maximum of 1, preventing the issues described above.
